description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project and handles the display of a search form for subpanels in the CRM interface. It initializes security checks, validates request parameters, includes necessary classes, and creates a SubPanel object to generate and output the search form.

classes.name: SubPanel
classes.description: A class responsible for managing subpanel display logic and rendering search forms within the SuiteCRM interface.

methods.name: getSearchForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the search form in the subpanel context.
